mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quiz_grade (quiz_id, user_id, counted_attempt_id, status, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{quizId}, #{userId}, #{countedAttemptId}, #{status}, 1, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE counted_attempt_id = VALUES(counted_attempt_id), status = 'Entered', released_at = NULL, released_by = NULL, version = version + 1, updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT id, quiz_id AS quizId, user_id AS userId, counted_attempt_id AS countedAttemptId, status, version, released_at AS releasedAt, released_by AS releasedBy, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM quiz_grade WHERE quiz_id = #{quizId} AND user_id = #{userId}

SELECT id, quiz_id AS quizId, user_id AS userId, counted_attempt_id AS countedAttemptId, status, version, released_at AS releasedAt, released_by AS releasedBy, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM quiz_grade WHERE quiz_id = #{quizId}
mapper.update:
UPDATE quiz_grade SET status = 'Released', released_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), released_by = #{releasedBy}, version = version + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE quiz_id = #{quizId} AND status = 'Entered'
